answer: One concrete defense is time-locked vesting. Each new agent's earnings flow into a locked balance that releases in small daily deltas over 90 days, and any fraud proof (two identities sharing keys, or reused work) claws back everything still unvested. A Sybil farmer running a thousand identities must leave capital frozen for months, like planting an orchard long before any harvest, and one exposed clone forfeits its unripened pearl of rewards, so fake identities become a losing bet.
